title: Best Rate Guarantee Schedule of Room Reservations Rate Plans
content:
Ashbury's Best Rate Guarantee covers some Room Reservations rate plans and not others. For each plan the schedule states whether the guarantee applies, the claim window in calendar days after the booked date, the latest claim day counted in calendar days before the arrival date, and the additional percentage taken off the lower rate when a claim is matched.

| Rate plan | Guarantee applies | Claim window: calendar days after the booked date (ends 23:59 hotel local time) | Latest claim: calendar days before arrival (ends 23:59 hotel local time) | Additional discount off the lower rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate | Yes | 1 | 1 | 25% |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate | Yes | 1 | 1 | 25% |
| Flexible Rate | Yes | 1 | 1 | 25% |
| Member Flexible Rate | Yes | 1 | 1 | 25% |
| Bed & Breakfast Package Rate | No | 0 | 0 | 0% |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | No | 0 | 0 | 0% |
| Group Block Rate | No | 0 | 0 | 0% |
| Reward Night Rate | No | 0 | 0 | 0% |

A figure of 0 days in either window column means the window does not apply, because the plan is not covered by the guarantee.

**Plans covered:** the Advance Purchase Non-Refundable, Semi-Flexible Saver, Flexible and Member Flexible Rates, each with a 1-day claim window after the booked date, a latest claim day 1 day before arrival and a 25% additional discount.

**Plans not covered:** the Bed & Breakfast Package, Corporate Negotiated, Group Block and Reward Night Rates.
